title: Canonical shifted comparison specified on section cocycles with independent coefficient universe
statement: For any ringed site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] with commutative ring sheaf R, object U, arbitrary cochain complexes L and I of R-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] and integer n, let S be the abelian-group complex obtained by taking sections at U of the sheaf Hom complex [def-pur-hom-complex], let res be restriction to U and Q the homotopy-category quotient. There is an equivalence e from S.cycles n to external degree-n cocycles between res L and res I, whose component at p,q with p+n=q and localized object W is the evaluated product projection applied to the image of z in S.X n. There is an equivalence a from S.homology n to homotopy-category morphisms res L to (res I)[n], and a applied to the homology class of z is Q applied to Cocycle.equivHomShift.symm (e z). This universe-general form takes C : Type u with Category v and coefficient/module universe max u v r, for arbitrary r; assume abelian-group sheafification and its locally bijective characterization on the original site. It uses the same sheaves, restriction, Hom complex, differentials, and induced maps as the original source statement.

proof.text: Work with objects in Type u, arrows in Type v, and coefficient rings and modules in Type (max u v r). Use the existing siteAbelianHasSheafify and siteAbelianWEqualsLocallyBijective instances on the slice whenever an abelian or exactness instance is needed. All these instances are proved, and the given base-site instances are retained.

Use homComplex_sections_cochains to obtain degreewise additive equivalences with the required component formulas. Use homComplex_sections_cochains_comm on those equivalences and formulas to prove that they commute with successive differentials. Construct the morphism S to the external Hom complex using AddCommGrpCat.ofHom. Each component is an isomorphism, so HomologicalComplex.Hom.isIso_of_components makes it an isomorphism of complexes.

Apply HomologicalComplex.cyclesMapIso to this complex isomorphism. Compose with the cyclesIso of Mathlib HomComplex.leftHomologyData. The cyclesMap_i and cyclesIso_hom_comp_i formulas identify the resulting cocycle with the degreewise equivalence applied to the section cycle inclusion. The supplied component formula therefore proves precisely the required representative formula for e.

Apply HomologicalComplex.homologyMapIso and compose with the homologyIso of the same external Hom leftHomologyData, then CohomologyClass.homAddEquiv. The homologyπ_naturality and homologyπ_comp_homologyIso_hom equations identify the image of a section cycle with the cohomology class of its external cocycle. CohomologyClass.toHom_mk proves the asserted shifted homotopy-category representative formula.
